mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.3pp in 3 months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines > 1% in 3 months and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% YoY signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY > 2% and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening demand-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and PAYEMS both increase > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: If HOUST and PAYEMS both increase > 1% in 3 months and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in a low-inflation regime.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% in a low-inflation regime and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases > 1% in 3 months and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.
